oḍḍita: oḍḍita [pp. of oḍḍeti] thrown out, laid (of a snare) J I. 183; II.443; V.341; ThA 243.
oḍḍeti: oḍḍeti [for uḍḍeti (?). See further under uḍḍeti] to throw out (a net), to lay snares A I.33 = J II.37, 153; III.184 and passim; ThA 243. -- pp. oḍḍita (q. v.).
oḍḍha: oḍḍha [better spelling oḍha, pp. of ā + vah] carried away, appropriated, only in cpd. sah--oḍhā corā thieves with their plunder Vism 180 (cp. Sk. sahoḍha Manu IX.270).
